sourceQuestions.sourceText: Clap each word. Write how many syllables. cat monkey elephant alligator
Write an animal name that rhymes. goat – moose – seal –
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: goat – stoat • moose – goose • seal – eel

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Circle the adjective (describing word). a the big hippo b a stripy zebra c a hairy spider
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a big • b stripy • c hairy

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Draw a line from each animal to a verb that fits. monkey snake frog lion / hops roars swings slides
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: monkey – swings • snake – slides • frog – hops • lion – roars

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Is it a quiet verb or a noisy verb? Write Q or N. whispering roaring rustling crashing
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: whispering Q • roaring N • rustling Q • crashing N

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Finish each word with sp, dr or cr. _ider _op (a drop of rain) _awl
Write an adjective for each animal. a ___ crocodile a ___ lion
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Any describing word, e.g. a golden / green / hungry crocodile, a big / proud / hairy lion

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Write a three-line animal list poem. Each line: an animal and what it does.
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: Three lines, each an animal and a verb (e.g. Monkeys swing. Snakes slide. Frogs hop.). Adjectives are a bonus.

sourceQuestions.sourceText: How many syllables are in tiger? ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 5 )
An adjective ( describes a thing ) ( is a doing word ) ( is a full stop )
Which word rhymes with goose? ( goat ) ( mouse ) ( moose )
To make a poem interesting to listen to, read it with ( a loud, soft, fast and slow voice ) ( the same flat voice ) ( your mouth closed )
sourceQuestions.answerKeyText: a loud, soft, fast and slow voice

sourceQuestions.sourceText: Which animal name has four syllables? ( zebra ) ( alligator ) ( cat )
